newsitem.title: USA: Quality Food appoints head of holding co.
newsitem.headline: Quality Food appoints head of holding co.

text.p: Quality Food Centers Inc said Wednesday that Christopher Sinclair will become president and chief executive officer of a soon-to-be formed holding company of QFC.
The company also said that Stuart Sloan will be chairman of the board of directors and that Dan Kourkoumelis will remain president and become chief executive officer of the operating company.
Sinclair was previously a senior executive officer of PepsiCo Inc. His primary responsibility is to pursue additional growth opportunities, the company said in a statement.
